description: Sets a new password with the emailed code (every session of the account ends). Then sign_in with it. [REST: POST /api/auth/password/reset]

lang.description: The account's language: ru, en, es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), pt (Brazilian Portuguese) or ja (Japanese); the messages, the emails and the texts of its searches. Default en.

name: reset_password
title: Set a new password
